func_08000240_71A750.title: Set the Control Machine opening-camera scissor
func_08000240_71A750.summary: Updates the Control Machine opening camera's scissor rectangle during the room 0x155 introduction.
behavior: The opening camera starts with the RDP scissor rectangle (left 8, top 38)-(right 312, bottom 202). A later camera state reaches (8, 16)-(312, 224).
The main display routine func_80017D8C_1898C emits the RDP scissor from camera fields +0x48 through +0x4E.
The native kind-1 sprite path through func_800087C4_93C4, func_800086F0_92F0 and func_80008920_9520 does not replace the camera scissor rectangle.
cautions: These values describe the native scissor rectangle for this opening sequence; they do not establish a general output-resolution or camera-aspect API.

func_80017D8C_1898C.title: Emit the camera's RDP scissor rectangle
func_80017D8C_1898C.summary: Builds the native RDP scissor command from the current camera's rectangle fields.
behavior: Reads the camera rectangle fields at offsets +0x48 through +0x4E and emits the corresponding RDP scissor command.
For the Control Machine opening sequence, these camera fields begin at (8, 38)-(312, 202) and later reach (8, 16)-(312, 224).
The observed native kind-1 sprite rendering path does not override this scissor rectangle.
cautions: This describes the scissor command path only. The full callable signature is not established here.
